report:
Reviewed the complete current claim, the single ordinary implementation association in review.rs::inventory, and the sole associated test test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement. No associated TODO/N/A entry is present and no deferral is being approved. Requirements are complete annotated function text (attributes, signature, body, contained comments); Cargo crate/target, Rust identity/file, inherited cfg and status metadata; and omission of source coordinates.

inventory selects the exact RustSite span from the indexed source and source_lines preserves it as newline-separated contents. Captured correspondence.rs context confirms function item spans include attributes, record carries the context crate/target/file/path, recursively inherited cfg is extended by function conditions, and UTF-8-aware byte conversion slices the source itself rather than reconstructing tokens. This retains comments and formatting. ReviewTest explicitly stores the six required metadata fields. Selector::Test stores logical identity with the fragment path; inventory discards internal span offsets when constructing the fragment. Neither serialized test metadata nor the test selector contains source coordinates. Extra LineRange reads have their own explicit selector coordinates, which is distinct from the test input metadata covered by this claim.

The annotated test asserts exact crate demo, target lib:demo, nested Rust path, file path, inherited unix and test conditions, and Ordinary status. Its exact capture_read equality to the captured TEST constant checks both attributes, full signature/body, comment and concrete assertion. inventory and select use the same indexed span, so this assertion plus the visible construction establishes the initial function snapshot as well. Recording then adding unrelated lines retains validity, exercising coordinate exclusion; changing inherited cfg invalidates it. A plausible truncation of the function/comment or loss of inherited cfg would break these assertions. Supplemental captured accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence asserts both Todo and NotApplicable test statuses from start and checks they survive accepted recording as deferred categories. Captured evidence::placeholder_status handles those enclosing modules, excludes the crate component and rejects contradictory nesting. This supplemental status coverage supports the complete claim without pretending the sole ordinary associated test alone asserts all statuses.

All dependencies used beyond initial fragments are preserved by review read: review specification, fixture/TEST constant and helpers, correspondence span/context construction and extraction, evidence status implementation, and supplemental placeholder test. Historical rationale was reassessed against the new representation and actual current test set, not reused as approval. I executed review start/read/record workflow commands and source inspection; I did not execute a test suite or cargo build in this review. The coordinator separately reports functional/review suites and root build passing; that is external execution evidence, not a command run by this reviewer. No behavioral defect or required edit was found.
